species.real: The wisp has a cast of local names, from jack-o'-lantern to hob-lantern, and a Latin one too: ignis fatuus, 'foolish fire'.
species.name: Wispet

dex.text: Drifts over the bog at dusk and offers to show you the way home. It has no intention whatsoever of showing you the way home.
dex.fact: Will-o'-the-wisp lights were traditionally linked to marsh gas, which can sometimes catch fire.

species.name: Corpsecandle

dex.text: A pale light that goes ahead of you down the lane, taking the route a funeral would. Polite, tidy, and not at all comforting.
dex.fact: In Welsh folklore a corpse candle was a pale light seen travelling the road a funeral would later take.

species.real: Welsh tradition said the size of a canwyll corff told you who was coming: a small light for a child, a large one for an adult.
